1. 노래중의 노래, 아가\n 1) 쉬르 하시림, ‘노래 중의 노래’\:
1. The song of songs, Song of Songs
 1)  Shir HaShirim, ‘the song of songs’
 2) Its genre is close to opera. Our Korean Bible just writes it straight through, so it's hard to tell who is speaking from where to where. For this kind of thing, you need to check an English Bible or the New Korean Revised Version to understand it.
 3) Of the 1,005 songs Solomon wrote, the most beautiful one is the Song of Songs.
하나님께서 인간에게 부여하신 에로스의 아름다움을 보여주고 있으며 남녀 사: It shows the beauty of eros that God gave to human beings, and it sings of the pure, innocent love between a man and a woman.
보통은 ‘우리를 향한 하나님의 사랑, 교회를 향한 예수님의 사랑을 우리가: Usually the approach is: ‘When God's love for us, Jesus' love for the church, is expressed as a love we can understand, wouldn't it be a love like this?’
구문 구절에 대한 해석 보다는 책 전체에 나타나는 한 남자와 한 여자의: Rather than interpreting phrase by phrase and verse by verse, the safe way to interpret it is to understand the erotic love of one man and one woman that runs through the whole book, and apply that love to God's love.
실제로 아가서는 남녀간의 성적인 사랑에 대해서 아주 직설적으로 표현하고: In fact the Song of Songs speaks very directly about sexual love between a man and a woman. That's why Jews can't read the Song of Songs until they're thirty.
그래서 아가서는 정경으로 인정되기까지 많은 시비가 있었는데 결국 아가서에: So there was a lot of dispute before the Song of Songs was accepted as canon, but in the end it was adopted into the canon because the love shown in it was seen as an analogy of God's love.
So we'll understand the Song of Songs as a book that sings of love itself, and move on.
You all don't need to read the Song of Songs for a while.
